description: Trace a raster image — a logo, a sign, a stencil, a line drawing — and extrude it into a solid, watertight binary STL ready to slice and print. The shape is flattened artwork given a thickness, not a reconstruction of a real object: use `photo_to_3d` for that. `size_mm` sets the longest side of the finished model and `thickness_mm` how tall it stands. Free — no credits. Returns the path of the .stl written.

image.description: The image to trace: a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/…;base64,… URL.

invert.description: Trace light lines on a dark background.

max_dim.description: Longest traced side in pixels (default 1600). Lowering it is the other way to cut the triangle count.

min_feature_mm.description: Discard detail finer than this, in millimetres (default 0.3, about a nozzle width). Clears the speckle a traced photograph throws off.

output_path.description: Where to save the .stl. Defaults to ./techdrawai-output/model-<timestamp>.stl.

size_mm.description: Longest side of the finished model, in millimetres (default 100). The other side follows the artwork's aspect ratio.

smoothing.description: 1 (default) keeps detail; higher values smooth the contours, and this is the fastest way to shrink an oversized mesh.

thickness_mm.description: How tall the extrusion stands, in millimetres (default 3).

threshold.description: Luminance cut-off between ink and paper. "auto" (default) picks it from the image. Give a number to force it.

name: image_to_stl
title: Convert an image to a 3D printable STL
